title: SCREENING AND CULTURING DEVICE AND METHODS FOR THE USE THEREOF
abstract: In accordance with one aspect of the present invention, screening and culturing devices have been developed which are useful for the identification of media which support cell viability, growth and/or proliferation. In a further aspect, screening and culturing methods employing the invention screening and culturing devices have been developed. In a still further aspect, methods for making invention screening and culturing devices have been developed.
